$comment: Where the AI-written docs' sources live (data/claude-*.json `basis`), so every tool can link them. `repos`: a source repository (GitHub `owner/name`, its default `branch`, the local `clones` npm run generate looks in, first found wins, and `env` to point at another; links are permalinks at the clone's `<remote>/<branch>` commit, or with `"ref": "head"` the newest commit of the checkout that is on GitHub; `site`: a docs repo whose `dir/<name>.md` is published at `url<name>`). `projects`: each `basis.source[].project` name -> its `repo` and the `dir` its files are under (or a fixed `url`, for a source with no file). scripts/sources.mjs resolves each source file to its path in the clone and stores the link in the model (`url`); a file it can't find gets no link and a warning. `data`: the other kinds of basis, `hub` and `engines`: the words (`{counted}` and `{families}` filled in) and their link (a fixed `url`, or a `repo` and `file` made a permalink like the sources). The commits are generated (the model's `sourceCommits`), never written here. scripts/check-source-links.mjs (npm run check-links) checks every link. Add a project here, not in code.
